In this Wednesday, Sept. 24, 2014 still image taken from video provided by KEYT-TV, Carpinteria Valley rancher Emily Miles shows scars she received after she was injured when she was attcked by a 300-pound black bear Monday, Sept. 22, in what is called an "unprovoked" attack near Carpinteria, Calif. The California rancher is recovering from scratches, a bite and a broken rib after being attacked by the bear that had been chasing her dogs through an avocado grove. She says she was on a walk near her home in Carpinteria when her two dogs bolted out of the trees, followed by the bear. Miles tried to run but the bear chased her down, bit her leg and clawed her back before it retreated and slowly moved back into the trees. (AP Photo/KEYT-TV, John Palminteri)
